setup.title: Set up the app
setup.intro: Create the first administrator account for this installation. This can only be done once.
setup.unitNameHint: For example: Pine Hills Ward or North Branch.
setup.unitTypeRequired: Choose whether the unit is a ward or a branch.
setup.officialName: The name can't include the official name of the Church.
setup.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least {min} characters.

approvalIntro.branch: The Church's guidelines for online resources ask that the branch president first approve their use in the branch.
approvalIntro.none: The Church's guidelines for online resources ask that the unit's presiding leader first approve their use.

privacy.title: Privacy notice

controller.ward: Data controller: the bishopric of this unit.
controller.branch: Data controller: the branch presidency of this unit.
controller.none: Data controller: the unit's presiding leaders (the bishopric or the branch presidency).

privacy.what: We store your names, your email and your password (stored so that nobody can read it, not even administrators) for your administrator account, plus the name of the person who approved and the date, as a record of the approval (General Handbook 38.8.24.2).
privacy.who: Only the administrators of this installation can see them. They are not used for anything else or shared with anyone.
privacy.howLong: They are kept while your account exists. If it is deleted, they are erased.
privacy.where: They are hosted on the services where the unit installed the app.
privacy.consent: I read the notice and agree that this data is stored to administer the unit's app.
privacy.consentRequired: To continue, accept the privacy notice.

admin.welcomeBody: Modules will appear here as they are enabled in this installation.

secondAdmin.title: A second administrator is missing
secondAdmin.body: The Church's guidelines for online resources ask for more than one administrator. Give the SuperAdmin role to another leader of the unit.
